title: Pawan Kalyan's Ustaad Bhagat Singh To Have 2 Hr 40 Min Runtime? Here's What We Know | Telugu Cinema News - News18
text: The buzz around Ustaad Bhagat Singh continues to grow, with the latest reports suggesting that the makers have locked in a tentative runtime. According to the report, the film is expected to run for approximately 2 hours and 40 minutes, making it a lengthy commercial spectacle for fans. The film is releasing on March 26 According to the latest report from 123 Telugu, the tentative runtime of Ustaad Bhagat Singh is 2 hours and 40 minutes. The final runtime may vary slightly as the release date approaches. Second Song ‘Aura’ Release Date Announced, Poster Out Mythri Production shared the poster of the song and revealed release date. “The man we love The man we celebrate POWERSTAR’S AURA IN A POWERFUL ANTHEM #UstaadBhagatSingh second single #AuraOfUstaad out on February 22nd #UstaadBhagatSingh GRAND RELEASE WORLDWIDE ON 26th MARCH, 2026. #UBSOnMarch26th," read the caption. Fans reacted with heart emojis. Release Date Announced On February 4, makers took to their Instagram handle and shared the poster along with the release date. The poster shows Pawan Kalyan in an intense avatar. “Get ready to cheer, whistle, and stomp your feet to celebrate our USTAAD This summer, the box office will be on FIRE with the duo of POWER STAR & CULT CAPTAIN #UstaadBhagatSingh GRAND RELEASE WORLDWIDE ON 26th MARCH, 2026. #UBSOnMarch26th," read the caption. Fans reacted with fire emojis. Pawan Kalyan has once again proved why his films generate unmatched excitement with the release of ‘Dekhlenge Saala’, the latest song from his upcoming film Ustaad Bhagat Singh. The track has recently dropped and has been receiving an enthusiastic response from fans. The film’s release date is not yet revealed. Taking to their official Instagram handle, the makers shared the song and wrote, “START CELEBRATIONS. Enjoy Dancing to the PAWANKALYAN’S BIGGEST DANCE BUSTER." Fans immediately reacted to the catchy number. Pawan Kalyan’s moves are making fans crazy. Many fans dropped fire emojis. Pawan Kalyan To Collaborate With Lokesh Kanagaraj? A report came in that Telugu superstar and Tamil filmmaker Lokesh Kanagaraj is in early talks for a massive action project. If confirmed, the film will mark Pawan Kalyan’s first collaboration with Lokesh, known for creating the celebrated Lokesh Cinematic Universe (LCU) featuring blockbusters like Kaithi, Vikram, 123 Telugu report says that Pawan Kalyan’s next project will be directed by Lokesh Kanagaraj. Apparently, KVN Productions is currently bankrolling Vijay’s Jana Nayagan and Yash’s Toxic. However, an official confirmation is made on this till now. Lokesh’s last project, Coolie starred Rajinikanth in the lead role.
